title: Matching estimate record
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let a record contain a coordinate set, a frequency prefix, and a rational estimate. The record matches a given coordinate set $J$ and frequency prefix if its stored coordinate set equals $J$ and its stored frequency prefix equals that prefix.
hypotheses_covered: A coordinate set $J$ and a frequency prefix, both subsets of the $n$ coordinates
